game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Coastal Port – Rope Walk, the rope-makers' walk: the sailor must handle jellyfish swarms while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Not Negator: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the sailor slips through safely.
theme: Coastal Port – Rope Walk: the rope-makers' walk
core_gameplay_loop: In Rope Walk, repeat each round: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the sailor slips through safely. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the stealth value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the harbor bell using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The harbor bell reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the harbor bell is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 6 (applied tier): Not Negator
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Not Negator' (Week 3 slot 5), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Rope Walk'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stealth changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against jellyfish swarms in Rope Walk.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The harbor bell reached with actions_used <= 21.
